item.title: Comment on Keep an Eye on Crypto Regulation by Ricardo
item.description:
Now that the Trump family holds an 80% stake in the Trump memecoin -- the stake was worth an estimated $40 billion as of yesterday -- Trump's financial interests are directly tied to deregulating crypto and other policies that make it easier for more people to buy up crypto.

And then there is Melania coin.

I learned recently that Trump has followed the same character arc as Andrew Tate. He denounced shitcoins for the obvious fraud that they are and how they take advantage of unsophisticated investors. Then, they both realized how much money they could make by releasing their own coins and dove in head first.
